lines.en: I stumble along after you
My wings are still too soft
I fly half a block and drop to the ground
I flap hard to keep up with you
I am knee high to you

lines.zh: 我跑两步就撞上你的腿
lines.en: Two steps and I bump your leg
My scales have not hardened yet
I run on a crooked line

lines.zh: 我用四条腿小跑着追你
lines.en: I trot after you on four legs

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后一摇一摇
lines.en: My tail wags behind me

lines.zh: 我从你的左边绕到右边
lines.en: I go from your left side to your right

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的翅膀，摔了一下
lines.en: I step on my own wing and trip
I flap myself up a block
I lie panting at your feet
My wings spread out on the ground
I look up at how tall you are
I am trying to stand steady
My head is a little heavy
I am waiting for it to harden
The tip of my tail is moving

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，小小一声
lines.en: I sneeze, a tiny sound
I crouch to watch a bug on the ground
I try to bite my own tail

lines.zh: 我把头塞进你的背包边
lines.en: I stick my head by your pack
I cool off in your shadow
I practice a cry, still very thin
I am too low to reach you
Will you laugh at me
I will grow big one day
My wings do not work well today
Can you crouch down
I tried to fly, and failed
I am growing, wait and see

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就把鼻子凑过去。
lines.en: When you reach out, I push my snout into your hand.
I grow fast, just watch
Your hands are so big
Do I not have a name yet
Can I sit on your shoulder

lines.zh: 我会不会飞得像风一样
lines.en: Will I fly fast as the wind
I do not want to leave you even one step

lines.zh: 我以后会飞得比树还高
lines.en: Someday I will fly higher than the trees
The pain makes me duck my neck
A little of my scales came off
I went down on the ground
I try hard to get up
This is too painful for me
I curl into a purple ball
I am still growing, do not hit me anymore
My wing got pressed
I shrank back in pain
What is this thing
May I eat a little
I have not eaten much yet
This is better than bugs
Can you break it smaller
I will sit and wait for you to give it
Is this for me
It smells good enough to eat
I will wait for you to put it down
You knocked me onto my seat
You have your weight on my tail
I fell over and got up again
I am too small to bump you
I press back against your leg
A shake of small wings sheds the dust.
You kicked me
The knock left me dizzy

lines.zh: 我翻了个跟头，翅膀沾了土。
lines.en: I tumble once, my wings smeared with dirt.
I get up and keep following
I am still very young
This one I do not follow
I only want to follow you
I tuck my head into my wing
I tilt my head at you
I am still too small
I understand none of it
You are the only one I know
I hide behind your leg
I bury my face
I try to take it in my mouth
My claws cannot grip it
It fell at my feet
I push it over to you
I cannot carry this
This is bigger than half of me
I hug it with my forepaws
I can drag this
I carry it in my mouth two steps

lines.zh: 我把它推到你脚边，等你拿走
lines.en: I push it to your feet and wait for you to take it
Something is moving there
I try a cry
I am too small, I cannot cry loudly
I move to your leg
I kick off with my hind legs

lines.zh: 草叶晃了一下，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: The grass stirs, and I prick up my ears.
I spread my wings out
Let me try one cry first
I edge half a step that way
I copy the way you look
I grit my teeth and try to look fierce
I cry louder than before
I stare at it without moving
My feet scrape the ground

lines.zh: 我缩起爪子，盯着它的脚。
lines.en: I tuck my claws and watch its feet.

lines.zh: 我学你的样子压低身子
lines.en: I copy your crouch
I dare not go alone
My feet paw the ground

lines.zh: 它要是过来我就躲你后面
lines.en: If it comes closer I hide behind you
I copy a low crouch
My wings are half open
I dare not even blink
My hind legs are loaded
With you beside me I am not afraid
I jump up and bump it
I bite once, my teeth are not hard yet
I bump and hide behind you
I cry out that loudly
I lunge and bite its foot
I bump it and bounce back myself
I bite and retreat to your feet
I cry as fiercely as I can
I try to sweep it with my tail

lines.zh: 我咬住它的尾巴，牙还软。
lines.en: I bite its tail, though my teeth are still soft.
I slam in a second time
I bite its trouser leg
I have come out of the eggshell
My shell is still beside me
My scales are wet
The first thing I see is you

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，摔了一下
lines.en: I try to stand and fall once
My wings have no strength yet
I crawl to your feet
I will grow into one of those someday
I have only just left the egg
My eggshell is still at your feet
I shake my wet scales
Even standing steady is hard
My eyes have not adjusted to light
I crawl toward you
I want to grow up with you
I cannot fly, but I can walk

lines.zh: 我以后会有紫色的翅膀
lines.en: Someday I will have purple wings
First I will remember your scent

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的鳞都翘起来了
lines.en: The fire made my scales curl

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，滚了两圈
lines.en: I fell from height and rolled twice
Water pushed me all the way down

lines.zh: 一支箭差点穿过我的翅膀
lines.en: An arrow nearly went through my wing

lines.zh: 那股术力让我全身发抖
lines.en: That magic made me shake all over
My belly is empty and my claws feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得贴在地上
lines.en: The thunder flattened me to the ground
